preconditions.description: X must be a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.
d must be a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (1 <= n <= 10000 and len(a) == n and all(1 <= a[i] < 10**18 for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If no valid array exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid array with n elements, each between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for subseq in subsequences if max(subseq) - min(subseq) < d) == X
postconditions.description: The number of valid subsequences with max(subseq) - min(subseq) < d must equal X.
